title.narrative: STRONG - Strong Red Cross Youth for strong youth in communities in Malawi

description.narrative: Half of Malawi�s 17.6 million inhabitants are youth aged 10-35 years, an age which is full of energy, creativity, and innovation. Youth are however facing several challenges which are affecting their confidence, knowledge and will to engage in organizations, their communities and society. In many areas, youth are especially challenged by lack of knowledge on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, leading to early pregnancies, school drop and gender-based violence. This project will build the confidence and knowledge of youth in the district of Chikwawa and Mangochi by capacity building the local youth volunteers from Malawi Red Cross Society. Moreover, this project will further strengthen youth volunteers� access to decision making in Malawi Red Cross Society, building stronger youth engagement and in the end a stronger organization. The project will be implemented by Malawi Red Cross and technically supported by Danish Red Cross Youth and Danish Red Cross Malawi office.
